fields.description_en: Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the user identifier for Maojing, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type: PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name, used for Android application customer ingest endpoints; SKILL_ID: skill ID, used for cloud-based ingest endpoints.
